# Pleiades Rome sample

`rome.json` is a field subset of https://pleiades.stoa.org/places/423025/json,
retrieved at 2026-09-25T18:22:31Z. The subset retains contributor/creator names, identifiers,
rights, representative coordinates, types, publication state, and location data.
Other upstream fields were omitted to keep the fixture small. No dates were added.

Source: **Roma**, Pleiades place 423025, by the creators and contributors named
in the JSON. Copyright © The Contributors. Reused and adapted under
[Creative Commons Attribution 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).
See [Pleiades downloads](https://pleiades.stoa.org/downloads) for the complete data.

The test helper adds clearly synthetic intervals to copies in memory to exercise
eligible place imports; these are not assertions about Rome's historical dates.
